Final ZLDA Between Bs LIC Realty and Royal CP Hotel Holdings L.P. AMENDEDANDRESTATED ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT This AMENDEDAND RESTATED ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT ("Agreement") dated as of the 11h day of July, 2025, between BS LIC Realty LLC, having an address at 42-38 27h Street, Queens, NY 11101 ("Transferor") and ROYAL CP HOTEL HOLDINGS L.P, having an address at 25-06 42nd Road, Long Island City, NY 11101, ("Transferee"; Transferor and Transferee are sometimes hereinafter each referred to singly as a "Party" and collectively as the "Parties.") WITNESSETH THAT: WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner of certain land in the City of New York, and the building and improvement thereon in Queens, New York and knowns as Block 430, Lot 16 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Queens County (the “Tax Map") being more particularly described in Schedule A1,which land previously consisted of former lots 14,15,16,18 & 19, (the "Lot 16Former Lots"); WHEREAS, Transferor purchased two of the Lot 16 Former Lots, particularly lots 14 & 18 (such two lots hereinafter the “Sold Premises", as further defined below) from Transferee in 2022, and as a condition of that sale, Transferor retained right, title, and interest to only 1.0 of the "floor area ratio,”" as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective as of December 15, 1961, as amended from time to time (the"Zoning Resolution"), that is generated by the Sold Premises (considered as if the Sold Premises was a separate and independent zoning lot), and correspondingly transferred right, title, and interest to 4.0 ofthe “floor area ratio" (hereafter, “FAR") generated by the Sold Premises to Transferee for use and development upon the Transferee's Premises (hereafter defined); WHEREAS, in accordance with the foregoing, at the closing of the sale of the Sold Premises,Transferor and Transferee entered into an initial Zoning Lot Development Agreement, dated 12/2/2022, recorded on 3/30/2023, at CRFN 2023000079824, the “Initial ZLDA") and by which Transferor transferred 4.0 FAR then-appurtenant to the Sold Premises to the Transferee; WHEREAS, subsequent to the recording of the Initial ZLDA, Transferor purchased a new tax 1ot on 12/24/2024(CRFN No.20250000002710,recorded on 1/3/2025),known at the time of sale as Block 430, Lot 19, on the Tax Map ("Lot 19"), which Transferor now intends to include and make part of the“Combined Zoning Lot"(as such term is defined below) pursuant to the terms ofthisAgreement; WHEREAS, Transferee consents and agrees to the addition of Lot 19 into the Combined ZoningLotpursuant to thetermsofthisAgreement; WHEREAS,in accordance with the foregoing, Transferor and Transferee are entering into this Agreement to replace and supersede the Initial ZLDA and to update the fee ownership and tax 1lPage

WHEREAS, Transferor, after acquiring the Sold Premises and Lot 19 and combining the Sold Premises, Lot 19 and the balance of the Lot 16 Former Lots into a single tax lot 16, as referenced above,isnow the owner of certainland("Transferor'sLand"),with thebuildingsand improvements thereon ("Transferor's Building"), located in Queens, New York and known as Block 430, Lot 16 (the “Lot 16") on the Tax Map and more particularly described in Schedule A1 annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land, together with Transferor's Building being herein called"Transferor's Premises"); and WHEREAS, Transferee is now the owner of certain land ("Transferee's Land"), with the buildings and improvements thereon ("Transferee's Building"), located in Queens, New York described in the Initial ZLDA) on the Tax Map and more particularly described in Schedule A2 annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land, together with Transferee's Building being. herein called "Transferee's Premises"); and WHEREAS, Transferee proposes to construct a new building on Transferee's Land, (said new building and improvements and any related improvements, additions, renovations, expansions, alterations, restorations, repairs, replacements and reconstructions thereto and thereof being collectively called"Transferee's NewBuilding"); and WHEREAS, Transferor also proposes to construct a new building on Transferor's Land, (said new building and improvements and any related improvements,additions,renovations, expansions, alterations, restorations, repairs, replacements and reconstructions thereto and thereof being collectively called "Transferor's New Building"); and WHEREAS, it is anticipated that Transferee's New Building will contain more“floor area,” as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution than is now available for use in respect of Transferee'sLand under theFARlimitation containedin theZoningResolution(considered as if Transferee's Land was a single, independent zoning lot), with the result that Transferee desires to utilize the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for combining Transferee's Land and Transferor's Land into a Combined Zoning Lot for the purpose of making available to Transferee additional zoning “floor area" for inclusion in Transferee's New Building.
